name: cargo-tracker-css-build
description: CSS and HTML minification build tooling for cargo-tracker production container

scripts.minify-css: postcss src/main/webapp/resources/css/app.css --use cssnano --no-map -o src/main/webapp/resources/css/app.css && postcss src/main/webapp/resources/css/dd.css --use cssnano --no-map -o src/main/webapp/resources/css/dd.css && postcss src/main/webapp/resources/css/title.css --use cssnano --no-map -o src/main/webapp/resources/css/title.css && postcss src/main/webapp/resources/leaflet/leaflet.css --use cssnano --no-map -o src/main/webapp/resources/leaflet/leaflet.css
scripts.minify-html: find src/main/java -name 'package.html' | xargs -I{} html-minifier-terser --collapse-whitespace --remove-comments --minify-js true --minify-css true {} -o {}
